anatomic_site_tumor: From selected prostate cancer patients (PC; n = 3), urine samples prior to radical prostatectomy and resected prostate cancer tissue samples were collected.
disease_state: Matched urine samples were collected from prostate cancer patients prior to (n = 12) and 3 months after local treatment by radical prostatectomy or intensity-modulated radiation therapy (n = 10).
material_type: We demonstrate that density-based fractionation of urine by bottom-up Optiprep density gradient centrifugation separates EV and soluble proteins with high specificity and repeatability.
sample_source: Mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis of urinary EV (uEV) in men with benign and malignant prostate disease allowed us to significantly expand the known human uEV proteome with high specificity and identifies a unique biological profile in prostate cancer not uncovered by the analysis of soluble proteins.
